description: Telemetry Traffic Counts and Classification is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Transport and Planning. Vehicle volumes, classification and speed captured at a 15 minute aggregate level from Telemetry traffic sensors located on the Victorian road network. NOTE: Most sensors in this dataset group vehicle classes into 4 categories but one site groups them into 12. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Transport and Planning . It offers 14 resource(s) in CSV, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
